fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./tools/release/... -run TestCut with a fake git tags and pushes once when every gate passes, never for a major, never twice for one version and never when a gate fails; go test -trimpath ./tools/release/... -run TestRecordDaemonRun with a fake daemon status appends a (commit, started) entry to the daemon-run history only when the commit is new; release.yml uses the tag annotation as the notes; the timer unit is in the repo and the VM runbook names it
fields.statement: A systemd user timer on the VM runs tools/release hourly in the root main checkout; each run first records the root daemon's running commit and start time in the daemon-run history the soak gate reads, and when check passes for a minor or patch it pushes an annotated tag carrying the notes, and the release job publishes them as the release body
